trigger: The first registered study yielded no fully qualified view. Fixed-pose RGB-D scoring nevertheless saw both ends in every pre-grasp, loaded, and post-cut frame of multiple candidates. Scoring-only node chords show deformation makes the nominal sheet shorter than the geometric prior; change of camera alone need not restore a material coordinate.
selection_rule: Retain the original failed qualification and select only for follow-up optical diagnostics: restrict to fixed eligible candidates with both ends visible in every frame of all three windows; choose highest supported post-cut fraction, then original order.
trials: Before looking at new visual outcomes, freeze the selected pose and run the same nominal and 0.5 mm depth-noise cases with existing v1.3.1 behavior, seed and safety checks. Score the same closure, reacquisition, completion and overcut conditions. A pass here cannot change the failed original qualification.
